title: FsStore: atomic write uses fixed CID-keyed .tmp name; idiomatic fix uses unique temp names
description: The current approach writes {cid}.block.tmp and renames. Using tempfile::NamedTempFile::new_in(path) + persist() is idiomatic Rust for atomic writes — it handles unique naming, cleanup on drop, and cross-filesystem check. The current approach works but forces callers to reason about the CID-keyed tmp race (see correctness finding). Suggested rewrite: let tmp = tempfile::NamedTempFile::new_in(&*path)?; tmp.write_all(&data)?; tmp.persist(&block_path)?; -- handles the ENOENT-on-persist case by checking AlreadyExists.
